features.note: A mile-long sandy beach on the James River, below cliffs.
A Guns 'n' Grillin' outdoor adventure weekend is hosted at camp.
A SCUBA Camp track for veteran campers.
The Sail Hampton Roads track for veteran campers.
Huskanaw, a rite-of-passage program with over an acre of ground developed for it.
Veteran Camper programs run in parallel with base camp.

provenance.notes: Tidewater Council Scouts BSA resident summer camp at Pipsico Scout Reservation (Spring Grove / Surry County, VA; 57 Pipsico Road, near Williamsburg). Name corrected from the scraped registration-event title 'Scouts BSA Long-Term'; prior id va-scouts-bsa-long-term retired (resolves via aliases.json). Address independently confirms the property. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/596-Pipsico2026); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
